key_insight: Surfactant kinetics matter mainly when dynamic surface tension stays high during impact; at low concentrations or high Weber number, wetting becomes much less sensitive to surfactant type.
engineering_relevance: For rough-surface coating, spray, and contamination-control applications, choosing a surfactant with favorable adsorption dynamics can significantly increase final coverage and improve wetting performance.
method: Compared Triton X-100, SDS, and Surfynol 465
Varied surfactant concentration, Weber number, and surface roughness
evidence_signal: The abstract reports nearly identical coverage evolution below CMC, strong differences at 2×CMC due to dynamic surface tension, and consistently larger final coverage for Surfynol 465.
watch_item: The findings are experimental and specific to the tested rough surfaces and surfactants, so transfer to other chemistries or texture scales may require revalidation.
paper_title: Effect of surfactant kinetics on the wetting following the drop impact onto rough surfaces
